raw_steps.instruction: 1. Navigate to User Management; 2. Click on Add User and click Add Internal User.; 3. Enter existing email address; 4. Click on Save
raw_steps.expected_result: 1. User Management page is displayed.; 2. Add User form is displayed.; 3. Email field shows entered value.; 4. Error message displays: 'Email already exists.'; Overall: System prevents duplicate email from being registered.
